ask.ru: Задание: «The graph below shows the percentage of commuters who cycled to work in three cities between 2000 and 2020.» Лучшее введение:

why.en: Chart type + what is measured + where + when, in your own words. Copied words do not count; trends belong in the overview.
why.kk: График түрі + не өлшенеді + қайда + қашан — өз сөзіңізбен. Көшірме есептелмейді, үрдістер — overview-да.
why.ru: Тип графика + что измеряют + где + период — своими словами. Копия задания не засчитывается, тенденции — это уже overview.

options: The line graph illustrates what proportion of workers in three cities travelled by bike over the twenty years from 2000.
The graph below shows the percentage of commuters who cycled to work in three cities between 2000 and 2020.

This report will describe the graph about bicycles in three cities and give my opinion about it.
